```{r }
#| include: true
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
if (!exists("p.target") || !length(p.target)) p.target <- p.gmdp
ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
  UHSTable,
  "UHS.qmd",
  target = Target,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target"),
  base = TRUE
)
Sa.log   <- TRUE
Tn.log   <- TRUE
TR.label <- prettyNum(TR.gmdp, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("fig.UHS")
if (!exists("CAP.MCE", inherits = FALSE)) CAP.MCE <- readCaption("fig.UHS.MCE")
SiteID.caption <- .requireOneTarget(
  .currentTarget("siteID.target"), "siteID.target", "UHS caption"
)
```

#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| echo: false

for (k in seq_along(TR.gmdp)) {
  cat("\n### $", TR.label[k], "$\n\n", sep = "")
  NGR::knitBlock(path = "/_fig/UHS.Vs30.qmd", stem = .composeTargetStem(paste0("uhs-tr", k)), labels = "rewrite", vars = list(TR.target = TR.gmdp[k]), root = root)
}
if (!is.null(MCETable) && nrow(MCETable)) {
  cat("\n### MCE\n\n")
  NGR::knitBlock(path = "/_fig/UHS.Vs30.qmd", stem = .composeTargetStem("uhs-mce"), labels = "rewrite", vars = list(ID.target = "MCE", CAP = CAP.MCE), root = root)
}
rm(k)
